title: Indian Masters Badminton: Sandhya shines with twin titles
summary: Sandhya was the host state's standout at the 48th Indian Masters Nationals in Navelim, winning the women's singles 40+ final in three games and the doubles 40+ title with Radhika Ingalhalikar.

title: Goa's Sandhya, Ankush, Sebastian storm into pre-quarters
summary: Early-round coverage of Goa's players at the 48th Indian Masters Nationals.

title: 47th Indian Masters Nationals: Goa's Sandhya & Leena strike gold
summary: Double gold at Mapusa: women's singles 40+ over Aditi Rode and women's doubles 40+ with Sangeetha Mari.

title: Goa's Sandhya Melasheemi wins bronze at World Masters championship
summary: Bronze in women's doubles 35+ with Sangeeta Mari at the BWF World Senior Championships in Huelva, Spain, plus a singles quarter-final. One of India's five medals at the event.
